$comment: Desi Maximalism motion data: celebratory but controlled. Same spring schema as humanist-minimal (stiffness k, damping c, mass m; damping ratio = c / (2 * sqrt(k * m))). Timings are rules of thumb for this style, not measured from references.
character: Festive and rhythmic, like a garland in the breeze or a decorated truck catching the light: rings turn into place, pattern tiles in, mirrors glint. Everything arrives in order from the outside in, then the piece settles and holds still so the message can be read.

springs.$comment: Damped spring presets. Ring and garland springs are a little bouncier than humanist-minimal's, because the motion is celebratory.

settle.use: Default: text, panels, the cartouche. Barely any overshoot.

festive.use: Petals, beads and rosettes popping in; about 15% overshoot.

swing.use: Garlands (toran) and fringes (jhalar) settling after they drop in: two visible swings, then rest.

turn.use: Medallion rings rotating into their final angle.

reveal.use: Rings and borders drawing on or rotating in: fast start, long gentle finish.

sway.use: Sine-like loops: garland sway, slow ring drift, breathing.

glint.use: A short flash across a mirror disc.

exit.use: Things leaving: accelerate away, never spring.

border-draw.use: The frame bands draw on from the four corners at once (symmetrical), outer band first.

bead-run.use: Beads and scallops pop along the border in both directions from the top centre.

mandala-reveal.use: Medallion rings appear from the centre out, each rotating from -30 deg (alternate rings from +30 deg) into place.

petal-pop.use: Petals within a ring pop from scale 0 in rotation order.

rangoli-trace.use: Kolam-like lines draw around their dot grid, all symmetric copies at once (needs pathLength="1").

tile-in.use: Field pattern (buti) appears row by row from the centre line outward, each motif popping with 'festive'.

garland-drop.use: The toran drops from above the frame and swings to rest.

garland-sway.use: Loop: the garland sways gently from its ends.

mirror-glint.use: Loop: a paper glint mark sweeps across one mirror disc at a time, in sequence around a ring.

ring-drift.use: Loop: one outer ring drifts back and forth by a few degrees; never a continuous spin.

headline-rise.use: The headline rises into the cartouche after the art; it never moves again.

drop-line.use: The flat ink drop line slides out from behind the headline by its offset.

durations.$comment: Rule of thumb. The full reveal of a poster is longer than in humanist-minimal because there are more layers.

choreography.settleBeforeText: The headline starts when the art is about 80% complete, and the art is fully still before the headline lands.
choreography.symmetricMotion: Symmetric parts move together (both halves, all copies in a ring), so motion keeps the symmetry.

loop.endsOn: The full still poster. Only one loop runs: garland-sway, mirror-glint or ring-drift.

rules: Springs for arriving, sine curves for looping, acceleration for leaving.
Reveal from the outside in (frame, field, centre), and the message last.
Only one loop at a time; text never loops.
Rotations settle at their final angle; no continuous spinning (it reads as a loading icon and is hard to look at).
No flashing more than 3 times in any second (WCAG 2.3.1); a glint covers at most one mirror disc at a time.
No camera moves, zooms through the pattern or parallax beyond 1-2% of the artboard.
With reduced motion: show the final frame; all loops stop.
